findings.location: source.html — proper name in running text
findings.source_quote: Two older boys, Big David and Paul, showed up with brand-new bicycles.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Indonesian ordering for the epithet while preserving meaning and the author's tone. For example: "Dua anak laki-laki yang lebih besar, David si Besar dan Paul, muncul..." or "Dua anak laki-laki yang lebih besar, David yang besar dan Paul, muncul..." Replace exactly the running-text phrase; keep surrounding HTML unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: Dua anak laki-laki yang lebih besar, David Besar dan Paul, muncul dengan sepeda baru.

findings.source_quote: These bicycles glided smoothly on the chip-and seal road without a rattle.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the sense of the specific road surface. Consider translating "chip-and-seal road" more literally, e.g. "jalan yang berlapis kerikil dan pelapis (chip-and-seal)" or "jalur chip-and-seal" if a technical name is intended. Replace only the clause in the paragraph.
findings.translation_quote: Sepeda-sepeda ini meluncur mulus di jalan beraspal tanpa bergetar.
